svg.title: Capabilities & Interests Carousel — Muhammad Abdul Rehman
svg.desc: Core engineering capabilities in RAG, LLM applications, and workflow automation beside a three-slide interests carousel changing every 4 seconds with segment progress bars.

g.text: Grounded retrieval, low-latency inference, and resilient multi-agent automation.
Parallel FAISS + BM25 retrieval with CrossEncoder re-ranking, RAGAS
evaluation, and dual-adapter Redis / SQLite semantic caching.
Full-stack apps integrating OpenAI, Gemini & Groq with LiveKit voice
streaming, prompt-injection guardrails, and ATS diagnostic engines.
Self-hosted n8n pipelines, FastAPI microservices, webhook orchestration
across Airtable & Slack API, and hands-free PyAutoGUI execution.
Designing autonomous multi-step AI systems that connect LLM
reasoning to real-world execution — from self-hosted n8n lead
pipelines with fallback branches to FastAPI + Groq IDE tools.
Architecting low-latency conversational voice agents like
FridayAI & J.A.R.V.I.S — bridging LiveKit and the
Gemini Realtime API with 15 system tools in English & Urdu.
Representing DataCrumbs as Campus Ambassador while
pursuing a BS in Computer Science at Superior University —
helping peers master SQL, data analytics, and practical AI literacy.
